statements.impact_statement: 2026-10-03: fixed upstream in OpenBao 2.0.3; this image builds a later 2.6 release (package.version in images/openbao/melange.yaml). Reported only by trivy --detection-priority comprehensive, which reads the bao binary's main-module version: the 2.6 module path has no /v2 suffix, so Go cannot stamp the v2.6.x tag and records a v0.0.0 pseudo-version, which compares below every fixed version. Delete with the openbao (2.6) image.
